That's a doctor or dietitian question, not a coach one — the right amount depends on how your body handles it, what else you're taking, and your health history. I can't give you a number.

What I can tell you: most runners use caffeine before a race to stay sharp, and it works. Start with whatever you've trained with on hard efforts — never try something new on race day. If you haven't used it before, test it in a workout first so you know how you feel.

What race are we talking about?
